name: Chicken Pulao
description: Fragrant Pakistani chicken pulao cooked with basmati rice, tender chicken and aromatic yakhni-style spices.
ingredients: 3 cups basmati rice, rinsed and soaked for 30 minutes
method: Put the chicken, about half the onion, 1 tbsp ginger-garlic paste, half the whole spices, salt and 5 cups water in a pot. Simmer until the chicken is almost tender and the stock is flavourful.
Remove the chicken and strain the stock. Measure the stock so the amount used with the rice can be controlled.
Heat oil in a heavy pot and fry the remaining onion until golden. Add the remaining ginger-garlic paste and whole spices, then add the chicken and fry briefly.
Lower the heat, add the whisked yogurt and green chilies, and cook until excess moisture reduces.
Drain the soaked rice and add it gently. Pour in enough hot chicken stock for your basmati variety and taste the liquid for salt.
Cook uncovered until most liquid is absorbed and steam holes appear. Cover tightly and cook on very low heat for 15–20 minutes.
Turn off the heat, rest covered for 10 minutes, then fluff gently and serve.
tips: Do not automatically pour in all the stock; basmati varieties absorb different amounts of liquid.
Avoid excessive stirring after adding rice to keep the grains intact.
storage: Cool promptly and refrigerate covered for up to 2 days. Reheat until the chicken and rice are steaming hot throughout.
